blocks.text: Kisi masle ko computer ke zariye hal karne ke liye hamein us ki characteristics (khoobiyan) samajhni hoti hain. Is ka matlab hai teen cheezein pehchanna: inputs, desired (jo chahiye) outputs, aur woh process jo inputs ko outputs mein badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Masla 'class ke numbers ka average (ausat) nikalein' ki characteristics bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Input: numbers ki list. Process: tamam numbers jama kar ke un ki ginti se divide karna. Output: average.

items: Masle ki characteristics: inputs, desired outputs aur un ke darmiyan ka process.
